decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's announced direction of binding mobile communication and builds on substantial prior R&D, so management will persist with it.
Mobile PDF signing fits the announced push into online contract signing, so any slow uptake is likely to be read as temporary market immaturity rather than failure.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the publicly communicated backbone of the integrated offer, which makes dropping it hard to justify.
The email-to-app delivery robot extends the secure communication channel the firm has committed to, so modest early results will be tolerated.
The QR hardware token carries sunk hardware investment and still serves regulated customers, so the firm will keep it despite the industry shift toward app-based authentication.
The payment security compliance suite addresses the regulatory demand the firm's positioning rests on, and its results can be attributed to slow compliance adoption cycles.
